ResearchProjectDef.label: wood-and-stone altar
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct a first-tier wood-and-stone altar to anchor 3×3 white chalk rings and unlock tier 1 grove rites. Unlocks building: wood-and-stone altar.

ResearchProjectDef.label: living wood
ResearchProjectDef.description: Awaken ordinary timber with herbal medicine inside a 3×3 white chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of living wood.

ResearchProjectDef.label: livingwood altar
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow a second-tier livingwood altar capable of sustaining 5×5 green chalk rings and tier 2 rites. Unlocks building: livingwood altar.

ResearchProjectDef.label: green ritual chalk
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work white ritual chalk and herbal medicine into green ritual chalk for 5×5 tier 2 rings. Unlocks ritual: rite of green chalk.

ResearchProjectDef.label: elven steel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Temper ordinary steel with living wood in a 5×5 green chalk ring to forge elven steel. Unlocks ritual: rite of elven steel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: star ritual chalk
ResearchProjectDef.description: Infuse white ritual chalk with silver and jade inside a 5×5 green chalk ring to form star ritual chalk for 7×7 tier 3 rings. Unlocks ritual: rite of star chalk.

ResearchProjectDef.label: starlight altar
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct a third-tier starlight altar around an engineering-station resonance core to host 7×7 star chalk rings and tier 3 rites. Unlocks building: starlight altar.

ResearchProjectDef.label: adamantine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine elven steel and plasteel inside a 7×7 star chalk ring into durable adamantine. Unlocks ritual: rite of adamantine.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mithril
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine elven steel and silver inside a 7×7 star chalk ring into spell-conducting mithril. Unlocks ritual: rite of mithril.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of mending
ResearchProjectDef.description: Channel a life pool in a 3×3 white chalk ring to heal fresh wounds and blood loss. Unlocks ritual: rite of mending.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of spellbook awakening
ResearchProjectDef.description: Call forth an apprentice spellbook in a 3×3 white chalk ring for a forest-blooded colonist to wear. Unlocks ritual: rite of spellbook awakening.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of the mana spring
ResearchProjectDef.description: Restore mana to nearby forest-blooded colonists using network mana in a 3×3 white chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of the mana spring.

customUnlockTexts.li: Ritual: rite of the mana spring

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of bottling
ResearchProjectDef.description: Seal network mana into portable mana vials using wood and herbal medicine in a 3×3 white chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of bottling.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of rune awakening
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock new spell runes for the colony according to the rune's tier and altar capabilities. Unlocks ritual: rite of rune awakening.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of spell inscribing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Inscribe a touch, self, or orbit spell from the host's spellbook into a weapon or piece of armour placed beside the altar. Unlocks ritual: rite of spell inscribing.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of mending (green ring)
ResearchProjectDef.description: Expand the mending rite with a 5×5 green chalk ring to heal scars and regrow lost limbs. Unlocks ritual: rite of mending (green ring).

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of the woven spellbook
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade an apprentice spellbook with elven steel and jade into an adept spellbook that raises the rune chain limit to 7 glyphs per spell. Unlocks ritual: rite of the woven spellbook.

customUnlockTexts.li: Ritual: rite of the woven spellbook

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of fertile awakening
ResearchProjectDef.description: Transform natural soil around the altar into rich soil using a 5×5 green chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of fertile awakening.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of components
ResearchProjectDef.description: Transmute steel and herbal medicine into industrial components inside a 5×5 green chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of components.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of the grove shield
ResearchProjectDef.description: Raise a one-way dome shield over the altar that blocks hostile projectiles and arcane missiles while letting friendly shots pass. Unlocks ritual: rite of the grove shield.

customUnlockTexts.li: Ritual: rite of the grove shield

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of beast calling
ResearchProjectDef.description: Offer hay in a 5×5 green chalk ring to summon a wild horse and attempt to tame it. Unlocks ritual: rite of beast calling.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of psychic severance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Channel a 5×5 green chalk ring to cancel every active hostile psychic ritual on the map and stun its participants. Unlocks ritual: rite of psychic severance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of clear skies
ResearchProjectDef.description: Dispel rain and storms over the settlement with a 5×5 green chalk ring, bringing clear weather. Unlocks ritual: rite of clear skies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of rain
ResearchProjectDef.description: Call gentle rain over the settlement with a 5×5 green chalk ring to douse fires and water crops. Unlocks ritual: rite of rain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: local teleport
ResearchProjectDef.description: Transport nearby colonists from the altar to an active teleport gate on the same map. Unlocks ritual: local teleport.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of seeking
ResearchProjectDef.description: Locate an overgrown forest ruin or an ancient engineering station on the world map to raid for relics and resonance cores. Unlocks ritual: rite of seeking.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of mending (star ring)
ResearchProjectDef.description: Complete the mending path in a 7×7 star chalk ring, restoring missing organs, addictions, and chronic conditions. Unlocks ritual: rite of mending (star ring).

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of the starlight codex
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade an adept spellbook with mithril and star chalk into a starlight codex with a 10-glyph rune chain limit and support for super runes. Unlocks ritual: rite of the starlight codex.

customUnlockTexts.li: Ritual: rite of the starlight codex

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of thunderstorm
ResearchProjectDef.description: Summon a heavy thunderstorm over the map from a 7×7 star chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of thunderstorm.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of sky wrath
ResearchProjectDef.description: Channel sustained lightning strikes from a 7×7 star chalk ring onto unroofed enemies near the altar. Unlocks ritual: rite of sky wrath.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rite of leyline mining
ResearchProjectDef.description: Draw deep underground mineral veins to the surface in a 7×7 star chalk ring. Unlocks ritual: rite of leyline mining.
